records.command:
git commit --quiet -m "fix: stabilize project library snapshots to prevent render loops" -m "Keep the filtered library projection stable between metadata updates. Cover repeated external-store reads, working-copy filtering and real refreshes; record live reload verification and unchanged project document hashes."
git push origin main

git rev-parse --short HEAD
git rev-parse --short origin/main
git status --porcelain | python3 -c 'import sys; s=[r.rstrip() for r in sys.stdin if not r.startswith("?? .dip/events/")]; print("\n".join(s) or "Product working tree clean; only automatic intent events may remain.")'
